name: Sabr & Shukr Urdu Art
short_desc: This unique hand-painted dark slate wall plaque features Urdu poetic calligraphy on Sabr (Patience) and Shukr (Gratitude) alongside a minimalist Sufi dervish sketch. Sealed with a gloss varnish, it adds peaceful, earthy charm to meditation spaces.
description:
Invite mindfulness and spiritual contemplation into your space with this earthy, hand-painted slate artwork. The plaque features poetic Urdu inscriptions emphasizing Sabr (patience during trial) and Shukr (gratitude for blessings), paired with a delicate outline of a Whirling Dervish figure with a red Sikke cap.

Crafted with high-quality white and red acrylic paints on a rough-textured dark charcoal gray slate surface, the raw stone texture provides a grounding, zen-like aesthetic that feels both ancient and contemporary.

A clear gloss varnish coat seals the stone and acrylic paint, preventing moisture absorption, resisting dust accumulation, and enhancing the deep gray hue of the natural slate.

Perfect for relaxation areas, meditation rooms, coffee nooks, or serene bedroom corners styled with natural stones, incense, and dried florals.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Premium acrylic paint on natural dark slate stone slab

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish seal for stone preservation and color defense

Theme & Script: Urdu poetry on Sabr and Shukr with Sufi Dervish figure

Color Palette: Charcoal dark slate gray, crisp white script, with subtle red accents

Style: Organic Zen / Minimalist Sufi Art

Ideal Placement: Meditation corner, quiet bedroom nook, coffee station, or spa room
